cohort: The study included 41 pregnant women with confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection in the third trimester, enrolled from two COVID-19 designated hospitals in Wuhan, China.
finding: Asymptomatic pregnant women with COVID-19 in the third trimester had significantly shorter hospitalisation durations and lower rates of positive RT-PCR testing compared to symptomatic patients, with no observed maternal or neonatal mortality or severe complications in either group.
